answer: A new key may spend only after it posts a one-time cipher of the current epoch seed, signed under its own key and checked against a public beacon that lists which distinct ciphertexts arrived before the close. The same wording or the same ciphertext is rejected, so a farm cannot replay one proof across many aliases. Release of a locked basalt reserve then waits until five established, non-neighbor keys have recorded that unique cipher on their beacons, which prices each sockpuppet in fresh entropy, capital, and independent witnesses.
